nodes.description: Public token name string set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string set in the constructor.
Public token decimals value (3) set in the constructor.
Total token supply storage variable; assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping(address => uint) of token balances; mutated by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)); written by approve and transferFrom.
Leprechaun constructor: sets metadata, mints the whole supply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
View function returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
View function returning the balance of tokenOwner.
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Debits msg.sender and credits to using safeSub/safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
Debits from and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits to, without verifying the allowance is sufficient or that the caller is authorized.
SafeMath addition helper with overflow require check, used by transfer/transferFrom.
SafeMath subtraction helper with underflow require check, used by transfer/transferFrom.
Caller-controlled address used as the owner/spender key in balances and allowed mappings.
transferFrom moves tokens using the allowance without calling allowance()/require, so anyone can drain any approved (or previously approved) account; access-control deficiency.

Function parameter to of transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines the beneficiary of the initial mint in the constructor.
msg.sender is used as the owner key when writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
msg.sender is used as the debit key for balances[msg.sender] in transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender key for allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
The caller-controlled msg.sender can invoke transferFrom for an arbitrary from address because the allowance is never validated.
Constructor writes the name state variable.
Constructor writes the symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Constructor assigns the initial _totalSupply.
Constructor mints balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom writes allowed[from][msg.sender].
transfer calls safeAdd when crediting the recipient, guarding arithmetic overflow.
transfer calls safeSub when debiting the sender, guarding arithmetic underflow.
transferFrom calls safeAdd when crediting the recipient.
transferFrom calls safeSub when debiting the source balance and the allowance.
transferFrom performs its state updates without ever requiring the allowance to be sufficient or the caller to be the owner.
The spender parameter flows into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
The tokens parameter becomes the stored allowance value.
The to parameter is the recipient credited in transfer.
The tokens parameter is the amount moved in transfer.
The from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom and is fully caller-controlled.
The to parameter is the credited recipient in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
The spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter a is the left operand of safeAdd.
Parameter b is the right operand of safeAdd.
Parameter a is the left operand of safeSub.
Parameter b is the right operand of safeSub.
Local variable c receives the result of a + b inside safeAdd.
Local variable c receives the result of a - b inside safeSub.

normalization_plan.reason: The spender parameter exists only as an input key of approve and carries no independent security semantics.
The tokens parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
The to parameter is the recipient consumed by transfer.
The tokens parameter is the amount consumed by transfer.
The from parameter is the caller-controlled source account of transferFrom and is the key input for the missing allowance check.
The to parameter is the recipient consumed by transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the amount consumed by transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter is only an indexing key for the balanceOf view.
The tokenOwner parameter is only an indexing key for the allowance view.
The spender parameter is only an indexing key for the allowance view.
Parameter a is a pure operand of the safeAdd arithmetic helper.
Parameter b is a pure operand of the safeAdd arithmetic helper.
Parameter a is a pure operand of the safeSub arithmetic helper.
Parameter b is a pure operand of the safeSub arithmetic helper.
Local variable c is only the temporary result of safeAdd and adds no semantic value.
Local variable c is only the temporary result of safeSub and adds no semantic value.
